scope: Explicit native route limitations; source-only display slices and measured runtime coverage do not qualify external F1/R22 acceptance.

routes.notConstructed: Actual native startup, linker/RAM setup, flash admission, interrupts and audio startup; post-reset crash-notice branch (both core variants) is not dynamically entered by the host walker.
routes.displayEvidence: The complete default/custom boot display renderer is captured separately through the host LCD framebuffer oracle.

routes.notConstructed: Actual hardware exception dispatch, timed fault loop and native reboot.
routes.displayEvidence: Exact fault-display prefix is captured with fixture crash registers; the prefix does not mark the complete wrapper observed.

routes.notConstructed: Actual watchdog/USB safe-mode loop, native PLAY retry and its STARTING DnBOX... transition.
routes.displayEvidence: Exact static safe-mode display prefixes, including both crash core diagnostics, are captured.

routes.notConstructed: Native USB detach, bootguard update and bootloader transition.
routes.displayEvidence: Both source-backed UBOOT display strings are captured as exact prefixes only.

routes.notConstructed: Real hardware matrix teaching, encoder acquisition, timeout progression and persistent calibration writes.
routes.displayEvidence: All declared button and encoder prompt labels are captured from exact source display statements; no device writes occur.

routes.notConstructed: Native LCD power/reset and hardware bus initialization.
routes.displayEvidence: Production higher-level painters use the explicit existing host lcd_blit/lcd_fill framebuffer oracle.

routes.notConstructed: Legacy drum matrix/tail fallback branches are not selected by the declared production page dispatch in this walk.
routes.displayEvidence: The admitted drum part route uses draw_drum_voice; ordinary strip drum dispatch selects DG_LEVEL. These helpers remain unobserved, not synthetically invoked to inflate coverage.

routes.notConstructed: The normal admitted engine/page cases do not enter these source-present original/fallback drawing paths.
routes.displayEvidence: They remain explicit source/runtime coverage gaps requiring entry-condition review.

otherHelpers: The report and stable-ID table retain every additional unobserved function classified NO_DIRECT_CALL_PATH_REVIEW_REQUIRED; that classification does not prove absence of callbacks or macro reachability.
